statement_hindi: सेक्टर-51 और 52 के बीच मेट्रो स्काईवॉक खुल गया, आना-जाना आसान
statement_english: Metro skywalk between Sector 51 and 52 is open now, easier to reach the station
basis: Rs 36.90 crore skywalk linking the Sector-52 Blue Line and Sector-51 Aqua Line metro stations; trial opening in August 2026, formal inauguration reported 4 Oct 2026 (Amar Ujala). Sector 51-52 is in Noida city, which the AC Wikipedia extent covers ('It consists of the city of Noida').

statement_hindi: छजारसी और बरौला में सीवर का शिलान्यास हो गया
statement_english: Foundation stone for sewer work in Chhajarsi and Baraula has been laid
basis: Foundation stones laid 14 May 2026 (Do Took Media): Rs 165.13 lakh sewer maintenance work in Chhajarsi with a 1,280 m sewer line in three lanes; Rs 978.68 lakh for a 10 MLD sewage sump well in Baraula. The article gives no completion date. Chhajarsi and Baraula are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: छजारसी और चोटपुर में 4.23 करोड़ की सड़क-नाली का काम शुरू हुआ
statement_english: Road and drain work worth Rs 4.23 crore has started in Chhajarsi and Chotpur
basis: About Rs 4.23 crore for 16 road and drain projects in Chhajarsi, Chotpur, Bahlolpur and Garhi Chaukhandi, funded from MLA fund, Accelerated Economic Development Scheme and Rajya Sabha MP fund. The article says foundation stones were laid and projects inaugurated, without saying which ones; completion status unconfirmed. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: सोरखा में 9.82 करोड़ का तालाब बन रहा है, आधा काम हो गया
statement_english: A Rs 9.82 crore pond is being built in Sorkha, half the work is done
basis: Pushkaneer pond in village Sorkha Jahidabad, cost about Rs 9.82 crore, about 50% of work complete, expected to finish in about four months; aim is water conservation and groundwater recharge (UP Ki Baat, page dated 11 Aug 2026). Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: सेक्टर-15 के नया बांस गांव में पंचायत घर बनकर तैयार हो गया
statement_english: The panchayat ghar in Naya Bans village, Sector 15, is built and ready
basis: New panchayat ghar in Naya Bans village, Sector 15, Noida, inaugurated on a Saturday reported 12 Sep 2026 (Chetna Manch). The article gives two costs, about Rs 230.86 lakh and about Rs 328.78 lakh for the building, and does not reconcile them. Sector 15 is in Noida city (AC extent: 'It consists of the city of Noida'); Naya Bans is not named in the Wikipedia list.

statement_hindi: सोरखा में 20 साल से सीवर लाइन शुरू नहीं, बारिश में सड़कें डूबतीं
statement_english: Sorkha's sewer line has not started in 20 years, and roads flood in rain
basis: Sorkha village, Sector-115 Noida (Amar Ujala, 30 Apr 2026): without a sewer line, light rain floods main roads; Bharatiya Kisan Union Kranti state president warned of agitation and called the authority's chaupal a formality. Amar Ujala video (3 Jan 2025): villagers say a sewer line laid about 20 years ago has still not started, and the main road is too damaged for sanitation tankers. The two sources describe the sewer situation differently (no line vs. laid but not started); the statement follows the video. Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: छजारसी-चोटपुर के डूब क्षेत्र में सैकड़ों कनेक्शन काट दिए, 24 घंटे बिजली चाहिए
statement_english: In the Chhajarsi-Chotpur floodplain, hundreds of power connections were cut, we want 24-hour power
basis: ETV Bharat (1 Sep 2026): residents of the Chijarsi, Chotpur and Behlolpur floodplain say hundreds of connections were cut over the past four days; they demand 24-hour power and permanent meters. The electricity department gave no statement in the article. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: सेक्टर-43 में पानी बार-बार बंद, बारिश में सीवर जाम हो जाते हैं
statement_english: Sector 43 water supply keeps stopping, sewer blockages during monsoon
basis: ThePrint ground report (28 Dec 2025): frequent water supply disruptions left entire blocks dry for hours; sewage blockages spread during the monsoon; streetlights stayed broken until a complaint was made. The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 43 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent ('It consists of the city of Noida').

statement_hindi: वीआईपी दौरे पर महामाया फ्लाईओवर से सेक्टर-51 तक घंटों जाम लगा
statement_english: During a VIP visit, the jam from Mahamaya flyover to Sector 51 lasted for hours
basis: Amar Ujala (24 Sep 2026): VIP movement in the city caused jams from Mahamaya Flyover to Sector 51, also Dalit Prerna Sthal, Chilla Border and Sector 37 to 51; peak jams 7-10 am and 4-9 pm. One dated event; 'whenever VIPs pass' is not established. TNP News (16 Sep 2026) is an election-framed piece on the 2027 polls; used only for its statement that traffic and parking have long been a local issue in the Noida seat. Noida city is covered by the AC extent.

statement_hindi: सेक्टर-31 में नाले खुले पड़े हैं और पानी भरता है
statement_english: Drains in Sector 31 are open and water collects
basis: Review meeting at Sector-27 club (Do Took Media, 1 Apr 2026): officials were directed to cover drains in Sector 31, clear waterlogging and clean the UGR in C-Block of Sector-31. The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 31 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent.

statement_hindi: दादरी से ग्रेटर नोएडा ओवरब्रिज बन गया, ऐसा कहा गया है
statement_english: The Dadri to Greater Noida overbridge is built, so it has been announced
basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026, updated same day): article lists a Dadri to Greater Noida overbridge among completed works, as stated by the local MLA at a press meeting; not independently verified. Completion date and cost not given. The article is Dadri-centred and does not name the vidhan sabha; Dadri town is inside AC 62 per the Wikipedia Dadri page extent.

statement_hindi: दादरी-बुलंदशहर सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, काम तेजी से चल रहा है
statement_english: The Dadri-Bulandshahr road is being widened and work is moving fast
basis: ETV Bharat (19 Sep 2026, published 11:25 AM IST): widening of the road from Dadri via Chitehra to Bulandshahr and Sikandarabad is 'going fast' (तेजी से चल रहा है), with a median divider, two lanes each side and drains being built. Cost not stated. Under construction, not completed.

statement_hindi: देवला में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू, हमारी लंबे समय से मांग थी
statement_english: CC road work has started in Devla, a demand we had for a long time
basis: Amar Ujala (26 Jun 2026, 7:55 PM IST): about 238 m CC road at Devla village, from the Dadri-Noida road to Aryavrat School, Rs 27 lakh; article says villagers had long demanded it. Work has just started, not completed. Article names Dadri as the assembly constituency.

statement_hindi: रूपवास बाईपास बनकर जीटी रोड से जुड़ गया, ऐसा कहा गया है
statement_english: The Rupwas bypass is built and joined to GT Road, so it has been announced
basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026): article says the Rupwas bypass was built to link with GT Road (जीटी रोड को जोड़ने के लिए रूपवास बाईपास का निर्माण कराया गया है), as stated by the local MLA; not independently verified. Cost and completion date not given.

statement_hindi: रेलवे रोड से नहर बाईपास, गाजियाबाद जाने में राहत मिली, ऐसा कहा गया
statement_english: Railway Road to canal bypass has eased travel to Ghaziabad, so it has been announced
basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026): article says the bypass from Railway Road to the canal has given relief to people travelling towards Ghaziabad (रेलवे रोड से नहर बाईपास बनने से गाजियाबाद की ओर आने-जाने वाले लोगों को राहत मिली है), as stated by the local MLA; not independently verified. Article is Dadri-centred; Railway Road is taken to be in Dadri town (inside AC 62 per Wikipedia extent).

statement_hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में पूरा सरकारी अस्पताल नहीं, बस बिसरख सीएचसी का सहारा
statement_english: Greater Noida West has no full government hospital, only Bisrakh CHC to rely on
basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 26 Jun 2026): Bisrakh CHC, a 30-bed community health centre, is the only government facility for the area; district hospital in Noida 35-40 min away, GIMS 50-60 min. Resident association president quoted saying Greater Noida West is home to lakhs of people. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri assembly (दादरी विधानसभा क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आने वाले ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट); Wikipedia extent says 'part of Greater Noida', without naming GNW.

statement_hindi: ईको विलेज-1 की बेसमेंट पार्किंग में बारिश का पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: In rain, the basement parking at Eco Village-1 in Greater Noida West fills with water
basis: ETV Bharat English (10 Jul 2026, 10:28 PM IST): residents of Eco Village-1 in Greater Noida West complained of waterlogging in the basement parking area, raising vehicle-safety concerns and water seeping from the basement ceiling. Replaces the earlier Tilpata item, whose AC membership could not be confirmed. AC 62 membership of Greater Noida West: Amar Ujala (25 Jul 2026) states Greater Noida West is currently part of Dadri vidhan sabha.

statement_hindi: दादरी नगर में बारिश में पानी भर जाता है, निकासी की समस्या पुरानी
statement_english: In Dadri town rain waterlogs the road, and the drainage problem is long-standing
basis: Raftar Today (page 'Last Updated: 7 Mar 2026'; original publication date not shown on the page): article describes waterlogging on rainy days on the GT Road to railway overbridge stretch in Dadri Nagar, a long-dilapidated road where residents faced waterlogging; officials and locals expect a drainage fix. Dadri Nagar is Dadri MB, inside AC 62 per Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सरकारी स्कूल, श्मशान घाट और पार्क तक नहीं
statement_english: Greater Noida West has not even one government school, cremation ground or park
basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 4 Jul 2026): residents say not even one government school is available, there is no public cremation ground, and parks, stadium and Ramlila ground are lacking; a resident says 7-8 years of demand for a government multi-specialty hospital. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri vidhan sabha.

statement_hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सोसाइटी का मेंटेनेंस बढ़ा, सुविधाएं कटने का डर
statement_english: In Greater Noida West, society maintenance has gone up and residents fear services will be cut
basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 6 Sep 2026; original publication date not shown): a Greater Noida West society's maintenance charges were raised; residents are unhappy; the maintenance company's email said services beyond the main facilities would be reduced; the article cites inflation, fuel prices and a guard salary rise as cost drivers. Article is filed under Dadri assembly. Source is a politics-heavy column; only the maintenance facts are used here.

statement_hindi: एयरपोर्ट के लिए जमीन देने वाले हजारों किसानों को मुआवजा मिल चुका है
statement_english: Thousands of farmers who gave land for the airport have received compensation
basis: Chetna Manch (21 Apr 2026, district-level airport acquisition, not village-level): about 7,000 farmers received Rs 8,016 crore for about 2,420 hectares acquired. The article gives these figures without naming a source, and it also reports allegations from unnamed farmers and leaders about unfair compensation. AC membership: airport-level; not confined to this AC.

statement_hindi: जेवर एयरपोर्ट से अब हैदराबाद और बेंगलुरु की सीधी उड़ानें मिल रही हैं
statement_english: Direct flights from Jewar airport to Hyderabad and Bengaluru are now available
basis: Daily Pioneer (16 Jun 2026): IndiGo's first commercial flight from Lucknow landed on Monday, the day before the report (the article gives no calendar date). IndiGo starts with eight daily flights to Hyderabad, Amritsar, Bengaluru and Jammu; Akasa Air starts four daily flights to Bengaluru and Navi Mumbai. District-level airport facility, not a village-level benefit.

statement_hindi: जेवर सीएचसी में नया मॉड्यूलर ऑपरेशन थिएटर बनकर तैयार हो गया
statement_english: A new modular operation theatre has been built and is ready at Jewar CHC
basis: Amar Ujala (5 Oct 2026): the modular OT at Jewar CHC 'तैयार हो गया है' (has been completed) with central AC, an air filter and a 5 kW power backup. The article says patients will get better facilities once it starts operating, and gives no start date, so it is not yet operating. Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Sarfe Jaya is quoted. The article's dateline is Yamuna City, not Jewar.

statement_hindi: एयरपोर्ट की पुनर्वास कॉलोनियां बन गई हैं
statement_english: The airport rehabilitation colonies have been built
basis: Chetna Manch (21 Apr 2026), reporter's observation that the R&R colonies 'दिखने में आधुनिक हैं' (look modern). The same article reports waterlogging and job shortages in them, so this is a looks-only positive. Dayanatpur and Raunera are the only villages named; neither is confirmed inside the AC.

statement_hindi: *एयरपोर्ट से इलाके में रोजगार और कारोबार बढ़ने की उम्मीद है
statement_english: *Airport is expected to bring jobs and business to the area
basis: Inference: Daily Pioneer (16 Jun 2026) reporter's words, not a minister's quote: manufacturing, IT, hospitality, cargo and MRO are expected around the airport, 'generating employment across a region stretching from western Uttar Pradesh to Agra'; a significant share of cargo capacity is expected to serve western UP agriculture. These are expectations, not outcomes; no Jewar-specific job figures were found.

statement_hindi: एयरपोर्ट के लिए जमीन दी, मुआवजा और आवासीय भूखंड अब भी अटके हैं
statement_english: We gave land for the airport, but compensation and residential plots are still stuck
basis: Press note by Bharatiya Kisan Parishad (Thakur Sudhir Chauhan, national secretary), carried by Chetna Manch (9 Oct 2026, 3:42 PM). It lists pending 10% and 5% residential plot demands, abadi regularisation and pending compensation cases from land acquisition in the Jewar airport, YEIDA, Greater Noida and Noida areas. No amounts are given. This is a farmers' organisation's claim and is district/region-level, not AC-specific.

statement_hindi: 335 परिवारों ने नकद छोड़कर नौकरी चुनी, अब भी स्थायी नौकरी का इंतजार
statement_english: 335 families chose jobs over cash and are still waiting for permanent jobs
basis: Daily Jagran (3 Dec 2025): 335 farmer families opted for jobs instead of a one-time cash settlement of Rs 5.5 lakh; the villages named include Rohi, Dayanatpur Kheda, Nangla Chhitar, Nangla Ganeshi, Nangla Phool Khan and Nangla Sharif Khan; the youths say they have been unemployed for six to seven years and protested on being offered third-party placement. AC membership unconfirmed: Rohi is named, but its tehsil was not confirmed from an opened source, and the families come from several villages.

statement_hindi: आलियाबाद में तीन साल से सड़कें पोखर बनी हैं, शिकायत का असर नहीं
statement_english: Aliyabad roads have turned into ponds for about three years, complaints have had no effect
basis: Amar Ujala video report (15 Sep 2026, by Anuj Kumar): Aliyabad, also called Mehdipur, 'in Jewar'. The stretch from the panchayat building to the graveyard is waterlogged; villagers say it has been bad for about three years and complained repeatedly to the pradhan and secretary without construction. AC membership unconfirmed: the headline places it in Jewar, but its tehsil or AC was not confirmed from an opened source. Based on the page summary; the full text was cut off.

statement_hindi: म्याना की मुख्य सड़क पर जलभराव, बच्चे कीचड़ से होकर स्कूल जाते हैं
statement_english: Waterlogging on Myana's main road, and children wade through mud to reach school
basis: Amar Ujala video report (7 Oct 2026, dateline Jewar, reporter Anuj Kumar): headline 'जेवर: म्याना गांव के मुख्य रास्ते पर जलभराव, स्कूल जाने में दिक्कत'. Standing water on the main road at a spot next to a primary school (the article names it as Aakalpur village's school); small children pass through the muddy road. AC membership unconfirmed: Myana's tehsil or AC was not confirmed from an opened source. Based on the page summary; no official response was visible.

statement_hindi: जेवर सीएचसी में अल्ट्रासाउंड मशीन है, पर चलाने वाला रेडियोलॉजिस्ट नहीं
statement_english: The Jewar CHC has an ultrasound machine, but no radiologist to run it
basis: Amar Ujala (17 Mar 2026): Jewar CHC has an ultrasound machine, but the radiologist post has been vacant for a long time; patients needing non-pregnancy ultrasounds go to private hospitals or labs. Medical in-charge Dr. Sarfe Jeya says no action has been taken on last year's demand for a radiologist. Jewar town is the namesake of the AC, so this counts as AC-specific.

statement_hindi: दादरी-बुलंदशहर-सिकंदराबाद सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, डिवाइडर बन रहा है
statement_english: The Dadri-Bulandshahr-Sikandrabad road is being widened and a median divider is being built
basis: Source: 'दादरी से चिटहेरा होते हुए बुलंदशहर और सिकंदराबाद को जोड़ने वाली सड़क के चौड़ीकरण का काम तेजी से चल रहा है'; median divider, two lanes each side and drains being built; no length stated; the stretch inside this AC is not stated, Sikandrabad is only the endpoint (town counts as inside under the namesake rule)

statement_hindi: अरनिया कमालपुर गांव में सड़क निर्माण और मरम्मत का शिलान्यास हो गया
statement_english: Foundation stone laid for road construction and repair in Arnia Kamalpur village
basis: Regional MLA laid the foundation stone for road construction and repair at Arnia Kamalpur village; the rajwaha roads (Vair km 3.30 to 8.30, Talada 2.5 to 4.75, Baroda 26 to 28.906, Hasanpur 10.20 to 13.60) are pledged or 'किया जाएगा' (future), not confirmed as started; no funding amount; article names Sikandrabad constituency and Sikandrabad area; AC membership of Arnia Kamalpur village unconfirmed (not named in the Wikipedia extent list, which covers all of Sikandrabad tehsil); published 12 Nov 2024

statement_hindi: सितंबर की बारिश में फसल खराब, जिले में राहत प्रमाण पत्र मिले
statement_english: After the September rain damaged crops, relief certificates were given in the district
basis: District-level: certificates for relief aid and agricultural input subsidy given at Bulandshahr collectorate auditorium from the State Disaster Mitigation Fund, for rain between 25 and 27 September 2026; number of farmers and amount not stated; no village or tehsil named

statement_hindi: चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा खाते में भेजने की बात कही
statement_english: Sugar mills say they sent 100 percent of cane dues to farmers' bank accounts
basis: District-level: four Bulandshahr mills say they sent 100 percent of 2025-26 cane dues, about Rs 1,092 crore, to farmers' bank accounts; mills named: Sabitgarh, Pahasu, Anamika, Agauta, Wave and Di Kisan; mill locations inside this AC not confirmed (Agauta is a name that may fall in the Agouta KC area, unverified); the figures are the mills' own statement

statement_hindi: सिकंदराबाद में करीब 10 करोड़ की 5 किलोमीटर सड़क बनी
statement_english: A 5 km road costing about 10 crore was built in Sikandrabad
basis: Article: 'सिकंदराबाद की पांच किलोमीटर लंबी सड़क करीब 10 करोड़ की लागत से बनी है'; the road was dug up by Jal Nigam for a pipeline about four months after construction, so the benefit was short-lived; the damage is the article's main point, see negatives; the town counts as inside the AC under the namesake rule; published 6 July 2026

statement_hindi: सिकंदराबाद में ट्रिपिंग से बार-बार बिजली गुल हो जाती है
statement_english: Power in Sikandrabad keeps going off because of tripping
basis: Article: 'सिकंदराबाद क्षेत्र में 33 जगह फॉल्ट होने की शिकायत ऊर्जा निगम से की गई'; cuts of 'दो से लेकर आठ घंटे' reported from the town to rural areas (district-wide report); the 'हर 15 से 25 मिनट पर' claim is Bulandshahr-wide and is not used for this AC; Sikandrabad area is inside the Sikandrabad tehsil extent; published 27 May 2026

statement_hindi: जुलाई की बारिश में सिकंदराबाद के सभी मोहल्लों में पानी भर गया
statement_english: In the July rain, all mohallas of Sikandrabad town were waterlogged
basis: Article (rain of Thursday 9 July 2026): 'सिकंदराबाद नगर के सभी मोहल्लों के अलावा औद्योगिक क्षेत्र और तहसील परिसर में तहसीलदार के आवास आदि जगह जलभराव'; Sikandrabad recorded 75 mm; a single event, not a stated recurring problem; the report is district-wide but names Sikandrabad nagar; published 9 July 2026

statement_hindi: सिकंदराबाद मंडी में गंदगी का ढेर लगा है, नल खराब पड़े हैं
statement_english: Sikandrabad mandi has piles of filth and broken taps
basis: Article: 'मंडी परिसर में चारों तरफ गंदा पानी, कूड़े के ढेर'; 'मंडी में लगे नल खराब पड़े हैं'; commission agents announced an indefinite strike until the mandi's cleanliness, drainage and drinking water are fixed; strike status after 14 Aug 2026 not confirmed; published 14 Aug 2026

statement_hindi: ट्रांसफार्मर के करंट से बच्चे की मौत, आरोप है शिकायत अनसुनी
statement_english: A child died from transformer current, villagers allege complaints were ignored
basis: Article: a five-year-old died from current on Sunday morning in Mohalla Kala Peer, Sikandrabad Kotwali area; current ran through the iron angle supporting a transformer on the path, which is unpaved and waterlogged; villagers allege the transformer lay there for many days and repeated requests to remove it went unheeded (allegation); published 31 May 2026

statement_hindi: सिकंदराबाद की कंपनी में 12 घंटे ड्यूटी, महिलाओं को 8 हजार मिलते हैं
statement_english: In a Sikandrabad company, 12-hour duty and women get about 8,000 pay
basis: Article: workers at a private company in Sikandrabad industrial area protested low pay and 12-hour shifts, demanding Rs 15,000 (women) and Rs 20,000 (men) minimum wage, and 8-hour days; the article reports women's pay of about Rs 8,000 a month; company not named; officials (ALC, SDM) promised to take demands to management; published 14 Apr 2026

statement_hindi: मेडिकल कॉलेज के नए भवन में अब इमरजेंसी के ऑपरेशन हो रहे हैं
statement_english: Emergency surgeries are now being done in the new medical college building
basis: Amar Ujala, 30 May 2026, dateline Bulandshahr (verified): emergency operation theatre for seriously ill patients started in the new building of Kalyan Singh Rajkiya Medical College; acting principal Dr. Sanjay Mishra says 30 patients have been operated in the emergency OT so far; general and orthopaedic surgery first. The article names no street address, so the town (namesake rule) is the basis for AC membership.

statement_hindi: इस साल डेंगू और मलेरिया के मरीज पहले से काफी कम हैं
statement_english: This year dengue and malaria patients are far fewer than before
basis: Amar Ujala, 1 Oct 2026 (verified): 8 dengue and 16 malaria cases this year, against 77 dengue and 53 malaria cases in previous years. The article does not state whether these are district or city figures; they sit in a district-wide section, so treat this as a district-level claim, not a neighbourhood fact.

statement_hindi: *सुनने में आया है कि कॉलोनियों की सड़कों की मरम्मत चल रही है
statement_english: *I hear colony road repairs are in progress
basis: Inference: the only evidence is the Nagar Palika EO's own claim in the 3 Apr 2026 Amar Ujala article (verified): damaged roads surveyed, repairs in progress, all colony and mohalla roads to be fixed soon. Residents in the same article say repeated complaints were ignored, so this is not confirmed as a benefit. Field check needed.

statement_hindi: *नए भवन में 5 ऑपरेशन थियेटर का काम चल रहा है
statement_english: *Work is under way on five new operation theatres in the new building
basis: Inference: a plan, not a delivered benefit. The 28 Mar 2026 Amar Ujala article (verified) says work is under way to start five operation rooms in the new building, expected from April, and that surgery was then done in one room in the old building. The 30 May 2026 article reports only the emergency and general/orthopaedic surgery start, not the five rooms. Field check needed.

statement_hindi: *हर विधानसभा में करीब 10 करोड़ के विकास कार्य मंजूर हुए हैं
statement_english: *Development works worth about Rs 10 crore have been approved for every assembly seat in the district
basis: Inference, district-level: Amar Ujala, 29 Aug 2026 (verified) says about Rs 10 crore of development works was approved for each assembly constituency, within 39 roads and works costing about Rs 70 crore across the district; first Rs 25 crore instalment released; tenders being prepared, work expected to start by end of September. The article names no road in AC 65, so AC membership is unconfirmed, and the works are approved, not delivered.

statement_hindi: कालाआम, चांदपुर रोड और भूड़ चौराहे पर जगह-जगह गड्ढे, बारिश में कीचड़
statement_english: Potholes in many places on Kala Aam, Chandpur Road and Bhood crossing; in rain they turn to mud
basis: Amar Ujala, 14 Sep 2026 (verified), city (नगर) section: Kala Aam, Syana Adda, Bhood Chauraha and Chandpur Road named among main city routes 'जगह-जगह टूट चुकी हैं'; rain turns them to mud and waterlogging; residents say repairs happen but the road is soon back to its old state. The two-wheeler risk and poor streetlighting point is in the district-wide section, not the city section. The 500 km figure covers the whole district.

statement_hindi: यमुनापुरम और कचहरी रोड पर कई घंटे बिजली गुल रहती है
statement_english: Power is cut for hours in the Yamunapuram and Kachahari Road areas of the town
basis: Amar Ujala, 24 Aug 2026, dateline Bulandshahr (verified), town (नगर) areas: in Yamunapuram power went off around 4 am and came back around 9 am; on Kachahari Road supply was cut from about 10 am and restored about 5 pm. A resident said he was told the grid supply had been shut off. SDO Kashinath attributed the Kachahari Road outage to a feeder fault, made harder to find by rain, and said most town areas were restored within one to two hours. Rural cuts in the same article are not used.

statement_hindi: कालाआम चौराहे और कॉलोनियों की सड़कें टूटी, शिकायत के बाद भी सुनवाई नहीं
statement_english: The Kalaam crossing and colony roads are broken, and residents say complaints were ignored
basis: Amar Ujala, 3 Apr 2026, dateline Bulandshahr, Nagar Palika area (verified): deep potholes on the Kalaam roundabout that endanger drivers daily; Hari Enclave road fully broken up; Yamunapur road dust reaching homes; Devipura road work stopped halfway. Residents say 'बार-बार शिकायत करने के बावजूद भी जिम्मेदार अधिकारियों ने समस्या के समाधान की ओर ध्यान नहीं दिया'. EO Nagar Palika, Dr. Ashwani Kumar, says survey done and repairs in progress.

statement_hindi: मोहल्लों में कूड़ा सड़कों पर बिखरा है, सफाई सिर्फ़ फाइलों में है
statement_english: Garbage lies scattered in our mohallas even though the city is shown as clean on paper
basis: District-level article, Amar Ujala, 1 Oct 2026 (verified): 'मोहल्लों में कूड़ा सड़कों पर बिखरा है'; garbage heaps on the roads of Bulandshahr, Khurja and Sikandrabad towns; about 900 segregation centres claimed but many locked; door-to-door garbage vehicles 'run on paper and GPS'. The town named is Bulandshahr (namesake rule); no neighbourhood is named.

statement_hindi: *बारिश में सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: *In rain, water stands on the roads
basis: Inference: the 14 Sep 2026 Amar Ujala city-roads report (verified) says rain turns roads into mud and waterlogged stretches. It does not say drains are the cause. Bulandshahr city drain complaints were not found for 2025-26; the 8 May 2026 Sikandrabad board report is a different AC. Field check needed.

statement_hindi: *स्याना से गढ़ तक की सड़क चौड़ी करने की मंजूरी मिल गई है
statement_english: *Approval has been given to widen the Syana to Garh road
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025) says the Syana-Garh road (SH-65, km 6 to 24, 19 km, Rs 59 crore) was approved by the CM on the Sadar MLA's proposal. Amar Ujala (24 Jan 2026) says the 19 km Bulandshahr-Syana highway widening (7 m to 10 m, Rs 58.91 crore) had its tender completed and work would begin in February. Searches in Oct 2026 found no report that work started or finished. The two reports name the road differently, the Rs 90 crore headline does not match the roughly Rs 100 crore sum of the items, and the km 6-24 stretch's membership in Syana AC is unconfirmed

statement_hindi: *स्याना-सिंभावली सड़क चौड़ी करने के लिए पैसा जारी हो गया है
statement_english: *Syana-Simbhaoli road widening has got its first funds
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026) says the government approved a Rs 14.44 crore estimate for the 7.35 km road and released Rs 7.22 crore as first instalment, with tender still to come. Only approval and funds are reported, no work done. The route is described as Bibinagar-Simbhaoli-NH-9; AC membership is unconfirmed

statement_hindi: *सुना है, जलभराव वाली जगहों से पानी निकालने सफाईकर्मी भेजे गए
statement_english: *I hear sanitation workers were sent to drain water from waterlogged spots
basis: Inference: Syana Executive Officer Sevaram Rajbhar is quoted (Amar Ujala, 23 Aug 2026) saying sanitation workers were sent to waterlogged places to drain the water. This is the official's claim only; residents in the same article complained of silt in the drains and asked for a permanent drainage system

statement_hindi: *सुना है पहले नालियों की सफाई हो चुकी है, सफाईकर्मी लगातार लगे हैं
statement_english: *I hear drains were cleaned earlier and sanitation workers are working continuously
basis: Inference: Syana Nagar Palika EO Sewaram Rajbhar is quoted (Amar Ujala, 3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report) saying drains had been cleaned earlier and sanitation workers were continuously at work. This is the official's claim only; the same article reports drains overflowing and Syana shops flooded

statement_hindi: *बारिश से फसलों को फायदा और उमस में कुछ राहत मिली
statement_english: *Rain has helped crops and eased the humidity a little
basis: Inference: a meteorologist at the Krishi Vigyan Kendra says the rain is proving a boon for crops and eases heat and humidity (Amar Ujala, 3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report). This is a weather comment, not a delivered benefit or project; it is district-level commentary carried in a Syana-area report. No better Syana benefit was found, so it is ranked last

statement_hindi: बारिश होते ही नालियों का पानी सड़कों और बाजार में भर जाता है
statement_english: Rain turns Syana's bazaars and main roads into waterlogged streets as drains overflow
basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026): in Syana, low-lying areas, main roads and markets were waterlogged and drain water was seen flowing onto the roads; residents blamed silt and dirt in the drains and asked for a permanent drainage system. Amar Ujala (3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report) says drains overflowed within minutes and Syana shops flooded, naming Main Bazaar and Kotwali Road. Amar Ujala (18 Jul 2026) says Syana's lanes were submerged, with Raj Market, Darshan Bazar and Kotwali Road under water, and vehicles stalled

statement_hindi: स्याना बाजार में अक्सर जाम लगता है, सड़क बहुत संकरी है
statement_english: Syana market gets jammed because the road into it is too narrow
basis: Amar Ujala (24 Jan 2026): the Bulandshahr-Syana state highway is 7 m wide, congestion is frequent, and Aurangabad and Syana are named as towns with congested main markets. About 10,000 vehicles and roughly 60,000 people use the road daily. The earlier 5 km widening from the Shikarpur crossing did not resolve congestion on the narrow stretch beyond it

statement_hindi: बारिश में स्याना की बिजली भी गुल हो गई
statement_english: The power also went off in Syana during the rain
basis: Amar Ujala (18 Jul 2026): power supply stayed off in Syana during the rain, while the rain also flooded lanes and students returning from school faced serious difficulty. The article does not say how long the outage lasted. Reported for one rain event only

statement_hindi: स्याना-सिंभावली सड़क अभी सिर्फ साढ़े तीन मीटर चौड़ी है
statement_english: Syana-Simbhaoli road is still only about 3.5 metres wide
basis: AC membership unconfirmed. Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026): the road is currently about 3.50 to 3.75 m wide and will be raised to 5.50 m. The article describes the route from Bibinagar through Simbhaoli to NH-9, so it is not confirmed to lie inside Syana AC. The article reports no public complaint

statement_hindi: खुर्जा के जीटी रोड पर नाली नहीं, गड्ढे और पानी भरा रहता है
statement_english: On Khurja's GT road there are no drains, so there are potholes and standing water
basis: District-level, not Syana AC. Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026), Khurja, Bulandshahr district: about 7 km of GT road built for about Rs 14 crore has waterlogging at several points, potholes, and no drain; PWD says only renovation and widening were sanctioned

statement_hindi: बुलंदशहर से अनूपशहर के लिए हर घंटे रोडवेज बस मिलती है
statement_english: Roadways buses run from Bulandshahr to Anupshahr every hour
basis: Amar Ujala (22 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr): article says buses to Anupshahar currently run every hour, about 6:30 AM to 6:30 PM, from the Bulandshahr roadways stand. Article also says extra buses start 25 Oct before Chhath and every 30 minutes once Kartik Mela begins (plans as stated). No residents quoted. Status after Oct 2025 not verified

statement_hindi: अनूपशहर गंगा पुल की मरम्मत का काम शुरू होने जा रहा है
statement_english: Repair work on the Anupshahr Ganga bridge is starting
basis: Amar Ujala (7 Apr 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr/Anupshahar): PWD repair and strengthening of the Ganga bridge; work to begin Wednesday 8 Apr 2026 at 7 AM; traffic on the route diverted for about 15 days. Headline says 'from today', body gives 8 Apr. No completion date stated; no residents quoted; completion not found in any source checked

statement_hindi: *बाढ़ से नुकसान वाले किसानों के खाते में 493 करोड़ रुपये आए
statement_english: *Rs 493 crore came into the accounts of farmers hit by floods
basis: Inference: All India Radio (12 Oct 2026): Rs 493 crore to 9,18,091 farmers for losses from floods, heavy rain, hailstorm and cyclone; event organised in Gorakhpur. Neither Anupshahr nor Bulandshahr is named, so local receipt is not confirmed. Statewide; weak positive pending field check

statement_hindi: *शिकारपुर से अनूपशहर के लिए रोडवेज बसें चलने की योजना है
statement_english: *Roadways buses are planned from Shikarpur to Anupshahr and Pahasu
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025, Ghaziabad): Bulandshahr depot plans two buses each on Shikarpur-Anupshahr and Shikarpur-Pahasu routes. Article says buses are not running yet and villages are being surveyed first; no start date. A plan, not a delivered benefit, so it is weak under the positives rule

statement_hindi: *सुना है बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क को चार लेन करने का प्रस्ताव भेजा गया है
statement_english: *I hear a four-lane proposal for the Bulandshahr-Anupshahr road has been sent to the state
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Ghaziabad): PWD has sent a Rs 175 crore four-lane proposal to the state; approval expected within about two months. An announcement only, not a delivered benefit; listed because no other planned benefit for Anupshahr was found in sources checked

statement_hindi: अनूपशहर का गंगा पुल खस्ताहाल है, सरिया तक बाहर दिख रहा है
statement_english: The Ganga bridge at Anupshahr has deep potholes and iron rods showing
basis: Amar Ujala (21 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau): deep potholes in several places, iron rods exposed, drivers facing difficulty. PWD Assistant Engineer Satyendra Chaudhary said heavy traffic vibration causes the potholes and patch repairs would be done soon, with full fix after festivals because of labour shortage. Article says potholes were filled several times earlier but repairs did not last

statement_hindi: श्राद्ध पूर्णिमा पर गंगा स्नान की भीड़ में अनूपशहर में 10 घंटे जाम
statement_english: A 10-hour jam in Anupshahr when pilgrims crowded the Ganga for Shraddh Purnima bath
basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau): jam lasted about 10 hours, Friday night to Saturday afternoon, during Shradh Purnima Ganga bath crowds. Queues from Mastram Ghat to Roopwas and about 2 km to Karanpur village on the Anupshahar-Bulandshahr road; the Anupshahar Adda to Bulandshahr Adda bypass was full. SP Dehat and CO Anupshahr came onto the roads with police; CO blamed sudden vehicle pressure and drivers going the wrong way. No future measures announced; no residents quoted. Mastram Ghat, Roopwas and Karanpur are not named in the Wikipedia extent; they are within Anupshahr town and its approaches, so membership is unconfirmed beyond the town itself

statement_hindi: गंगा उफान पर, घाट डूबे, गंगा द्वार की सड़क तक पानी पहुंचा
statement_english: Ganga flood covered Anupshahr ghats and the road to Gangadwar, and farm crops went under water
basis: Patrika (published 31 Jul 2026, datelined Anupshahr, Bulandshahr): Ganga rose quickly at Anupshahr; several main ghats submerged; flood water reached the main road to Gangadwar; flood water covered forest and farm land in Ahar, Mubarakpur, Margpur, Sirora, Torai and Bachchi Khera; maize, jowar, bajra and sugarcane standing in fields began to go under water. Ahar and Serora (Sirora) appear in the Wikipedia extent of AC 67; Gangadwar and the ghats are within Anupshahr town. The source URL sits under a bijnor-news path but its content concerns Anupshahr

statement_hindi: बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क सिर्फ 10 मीटर चौड़ी है, रोज डेढ़ लाख गाड़ियां चलती हैं
statement_english: The Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway is only 10 metres wide with about 1.5 lakh vehicles a day
basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): the state highway is 10 m wide now; it was widened from 7 m about eight years ago; about 1.5 lakh vehicles use it daily. PWD has sent a Rs 175 crore four-laning proposal. The road runs between Bulandshahr and Anupshahr; AC membership of the Bulandshahr end is not confirmed, so this is partly district-level

statement_hindi: सुबह के जाम में सब्जी किसानों को मंडी जाने में परेशानी
statement_english: Morning traffic jams make it hard for vegetable farmers to reach the Anupshahr and Bulandshahr mandis
basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): thousands of farmers from villages near the highway bring vegetables daily to the Bulandshahr and Anupshahr mandis; heavy morning traffic causes them significant trouble. No farmer quoted; the claim is the article's own. District-level along the highway

statement_hindi: चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा किसानों के खाते में भेज दिया
statement_english: Sugar mills have sent the full cane payment into farmers' accounts
basis: District-level, not Dibai-specific: ChiniMandi (8 Jul 2026) says the four Bulandshahr mills of the 2025-26 season (Sabitgarh; Anamika at Agauta; Wave at Bulandshahr; Di Kisan at Anupshahr) have sent 100% of the payment for cane bought to farmers' bank accounts, total Rs 1,09,209.12 lakh. The article does not mention Dibai or any mill in Dibai

statement_hindi: वीसीबी जलने पर भी करीब तीन घंटे में बिजली लौट आई
statement_english: Power came back in about three hours after the VCB fire
basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026): a technical fault set fire to a VCB machine around 10:24 PM on the Monday night, cutting supply in Dibai for about three hours; power returned once the fault was fixed. Dibai consumers had faced low voltage, tripping and undeclared cuts for the three days before it. A single restoration, not a lasting fix

statement_hindi: डिबाई में सामूहिक विवाह योजना से 150 शादियां हुईं
statement_english: 150 couples were married under the state mass-marriage scheme in Dibai
basis: Janmat News (19 Feb 2026): a mass-marriage event under the Chief Minister's Samuhik Vivah scheme was held at Ravan ki Patwari in Dibai nagar, with 150 weddings. The article does not say how many couples were from Dibai, so this is a scheme event held in Dibai, not a count of Dibai beneficiaries

statement_hindi: *डिबाई में मंडी चलती है
statement_english: *A mandi operates in Dibai
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026) names Mandi Hardev as a spot where waterlogging blocked traffic in Dibai, which implies a mandi operates there; no source found on crop sales, procurement or prices at the Dibai mandi (searches this round returned only other districts). Field check needed

statement_hindi: *डिबाई में सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र है
statement_english: *Dibai has a community health centre
basis: Inference: a search result listed a Community Health Centre Dibai on the Bulandshahr district hospital page, but that page returned HTTP 503 when fetched, so it is not cited. No 2026 report on services at the Dibai facility was found. Field check needed; replaces an earlier tehsil-office item, which was a geography fact and not a benefit

statement_hindi: डिबाई में रोज़ 10 से 12 घंटे बिजली कटती है
statement_english: Power is cut for 10 to 12 hours a day in Dibai
basis: Amar Ujala (13 Jul 2026): a table of daily average outage hours gives Dibai as 10 से 12 घंटे (Shikarpur, AC 69, is in the same table row and is not used here). The table sits in a report on a protest in Bulandshahr city, and the article also says most villages face 8 to 10 hours of daily cuts. Chief Engineer Sanjeev Kumar blamed higher summer load for the faults. Dibai is the namesake town of the AC, so it counts as inside the AC

statement_hindi: डिबाई में बारिश हुई तो बाजार और दुकानों में पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: Market shops in Dibai flood when it rains
basis: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): after about 45 minutes of heavy rain, Mahadev Chauraha, Paith Chauraha, Holi Gate and Bada Bazar had two to three feet of water, and shops on Railway Road were flooded. Shopkeepers were angry and councillors said shopkeepers have long demanded a fix; the EO and chairperson were asked to solve it. The article says the rain exposed the municipality's drainage claims. No official response is quoted

statement_hindi: डिबाई में बार-बार ट्रिपिंग और बिना बताए बिजली कटौती से परेशानी
statement_english: Power trips and goes off without notice in Dibai
basis: Amar Ujala (1 Jul 2026): residents of Dibai faced unannounced cuts and repeated tripping for ten days; flour mills could not grind wheat and children's studies were affected. Trader representative Deepak Agarwal gave a memorandum to XEN Rahul Ratn Bodhi seeking advance notice of cuts. The XEN attributed the disruptions to transformer overloading, and the article says work is ongoing on feeders one and two

statement_hindi: डिबाई का बाईपास अधूरा पड़ा है और हाईवे पर जाम लगता है
statement_english: Dibai bypass is incomplete and highway jams happen in Dibai
basis: Amar Ujala (14 May 2025, district plan article): says the incomplete bypass in Dibai and Sikandarabad will be completed, and gives a 6.80 km Dibai bypass costing Rs 45.50 crore as a proposal; no work reported as started or complete, and the plans await government approval. Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): people were stuck in highway jams in Dibai during the rain. No 2026 status report on the bypass was found, so 'incomplete' rests on the 2025 article

statement_hindi: सुबह सड़कों पर कचरे के ढेर लगे मिलते हैं
statement_english: Garbage heaps are found on the streets in the morning
basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2026), in an article on cleanliness in Bulandshahr, says garbage heaps are found on the streets in the morning. Dibai nagar palika is named only in a list of district bodies, with no Dibai-specific figure, so this is not counted in ac_specific_negatives

statement_hindi: अनूपशहर वाली सड़क का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है
statement_english: Widening work on the Anupshahr road has started
basis: Amar Ujala (12 May 2025), opened and checked: widening of the Anupshahr-Shikarpur road has begun; cost Rs 31.28 crore; work started after the first instalment of over Rs 10 crore. The article says the road connects Shikarpur and Khurja; it does not name the stretch or give a completion date. Route-level, so AC membership of the stretch is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: *सड़कों, नालियों और पुलियों पर 2.90 करोड़ खर्च होंगे
statement_english: *2.90 crore is to be spent on town roads, drains and culverts
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026), opened and checked: Shikarpur Nagar Palika Parishad will spend Rs 2.90 crore on 20 works, mainly roads, drains and culverts, funded from the 15th Finance Commission, State Finance Commission and municipal funds. No start or completion date is given, so this is planned spending, not delivered work.

statement_hindi: *मुफ्तीवाड़ा और कोटशेर खां में पानी की पाइपलाइन बिछने वाली है
statement_english: *Water pipelines are to be laid in Muftiwara and Kotsher Khan
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026), opened and checked: tenders are complete for about Rs 1.22 crore of works, including 783 m of pipeline in Muftiwara (ward 4, Rs 16.48 lakh) and 1,490 m in Kotsher Khan (ward 19, Rs 15.07 lakh). The works are planned; no start date and no completion are reported.

statement_hindi: *सुना है बैनामे के सात दिन में मुआवजा खाते में आ जाता है
statement_english: *I hear compensation reaches accounts within seven days of the deed
basis: Inference: ETV Bharat (2 Jul 2026), opened and checked: SDM Ravindra Pratap Singh says payment is sent to farmers' accounts within 7 days of the official sale deed; 62 deeds are done so far, and about 6 km of the Bulandshahr-Jewar expressway route is affected in Shikarpur tehsil. This is an official claim. The article has no farmer confirmation and gives no amount, so delivery is not verified.

statement_hindi: *शहर के 15 हैंडपंप ठीक कराए जाने हैं
statement_english: *Fifteen handpumps in town are to be repaired
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026), opened and checked: re-boring of 15 India Mark handpumps is among the Rs 1.22 crore Nagar Palika works, and the article says tenders for all works are complete. Repair is planned; the article does not report it as done.

statement_hindi: हल्की बारिश में सड़कों, बाज़ार और सीएचसी के सामने पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: Light rain floods our roads, the market and the front of the CHC
basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026), opened and checked: Balaji Market and the Kotwali turn in Shikarpur town are waterlogged; residents blame garbage in a culvert and drains not cleaned on time; EO Neetu Singh says drains have been cleaned and problem spots will be inspected. Royal Bulletin (23 Aug 2026): water on the main roads and crossings of Shikarpur Nagar after light rain. Dynamite News (9 May 2026): waterlogging in front of the CHC and block office in the Nagar Palika area. Amar Ujala video (7 Jul 2026): the same spot on the Khurja-Shikarpur road in front of the CHC and block office. The Syana part of the 23 Aug article is excluded because Syana is not confirmed inside this AC. The Girls Inter College spot appears only in a photo caption, so it is not used.

statement_hindi: नया केबल डालने के बाद भी शिकारपुर में 36 घंटे बिजली गुल रही
statement_english: Power was off for 36 hours in Shikarpur even after a new cable was laid
basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026), opened and checked: the outage in Shikarpur continued for 36 hours even after a new cable was laid. A storm and rain caused breakdowns on the Mangraul and Chitsaun feeders, which the article links to more than 10 villages; the Executive Engineer says a 33 KVA line broke down in the storm. Feeder village membership is not confirmed. The article's Dibai and other areas are not part of this item.

statement_hindi: आरोप है, सीएचसी में दवा बाहर से लेने को कहा जाता है
statement_english: It is alleged that patients are told to buy medicines from outside the CHC
basis: Knews (10 Sep 2026), opened and checked: allegations that poor and labour patients at Shikarpur CHC are told to buy medicines from private medical stores, and a local allegation of a commission racket between the CHC in-charge and some doctors. The article says these allegations are not independently confirmed. CMO Dr Sunil Kumar Dohri says all necessary medicines are available in hospitals. Allegation only, not verified.

statement_hindi: आवारा पशु फसल उजाड़ते हैं और गन्ने का बकाया पड़ा है
statement_english: Stray cattle wreck our crops and sugarcane dues are still pending
basis: Amar Ujala (14 Jul 2025), opened and checked: BKU farmers' padyatra from Jakhaita village to Shikarpur tehsil listed crop damage by stray cattle, low electricity, damaged roads, unpaid sugarcane dues and fake fertiliser and seed; a memorandum went to the SDM and CO and no official response is reported. Jakhaita's tehsil membership is not confirmed. ETV Bharat (4 Apr 2026, district-level BKU demands) repeats the stray-animal and sugarcane-dues demands. No 2026 Shikarpur-specific update found.

statement_hindi: खुर्जा-शिकारपुर सड़क 15 साल से जर्जर है
statement_english: The Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years
basis: Amar Ujala (20 Dec 2024), opened and checked: the Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years; approval was given for about Rs 22.11 crore (article: Rs 22 crore 10 lakh 94 thousand) for about 35 villages, and construction is still to start after budget approval. Amar Ujala video (7 Jul 2026) confirms waterlogging on this road in front of the Shikarpur CHC and block office, which confirms the Shikarpur town stretch. The 2024 figure is dated. The article gives 13.650 km in the body (13 km in the lead). The Khurja end may lie in another AC, which is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: खुर्जा में मेडिकल कॉलेज शुरू हुआ, अब कई इलाज यहीं हो जाते हैं
statement_english: Khurja's medical college has started, and many treatments now happen here
basis: Acting principal Dr. Sanjay Mishra says the Kalyan Singh Government Medical College (named for Khurja) started about two years ago and now teaches MBBS. The article says residents earlier went to Meerut or Noida for many treatments and that many services are now local. The article's dateline is Bulandshahr (district-level ground report); the college itself is named Khurja.

statement_hindi: खुर्जा का 660 मेगावाट बिजली यूनिट चालू हुआ, रोजगार की उम्मीद है
statement_english: A new 660 MW power unit has started at Khurja, and people expect jobs from it
basis: Amar Ujala (30 May 2025): PM inaugurated the first 660 MW unit virtually on 30 May 2025; the article's timeline gives operations from 26 January 2025. Project executive director says more than about 5,000 people will get employment (a forward projection, not a count). Article places the plant at Dashehra village in the Khurja area. THDC's own page says the plant land lies in four villages of Khurja Tehsil, which is the AC's Wikipedia extent, but does not name Dashehra. AC membership at village level unconfirmed.

statement_hindi: ओडीओपी और सरकारी मदद से बर्तनों के कारोबार को फायदा हो रहा है
statement_english: ODOP scheme and government support are helping pottery traders grow their business
basis: Trader Anshul Goyal says government support and ODOP promotion are helping pottery reach markets and grow; his account, no sales figures. District-level: the article's dateline is Bulandshahr and the fetched ODOP section does not name Khurja.

statement_hindi: चमन विहार कॉलोनी में सड़क और नाली का काम शुरू हुआ है
statement_english: Road and drain work has started in Chaman Vihar colony of Khurja city
basis: Amar Ujala (11 Sep 2026), dateline Khurja: Nagar Palika Adhyaksh inaugurated the start on Thursday of about 200 m cemented road and drain in Ward 22 Chaman Vihar colony, about Rs 22 lakh for this colony. Headline says Rs 1.10 crore and body Rs 1.20 crore for four colonies; the body's breakdown adds to 1.20 crore. Work has started; other road works in the report are still future.

statement_hindi: 21 कॉलोनियों में सड़क और नाली के लिए पैसा मंजूर हो गया है
statement_english: Money has been sanctioned for road and drain work in 21 colonies of Khurja
basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026): about Rs 2.78 crore proposal for road and drain work in 21 colonies approved, budget sanction received, departmental tender nearly complete; DUDA work still in future tense, so construction has not started. Headline says 2.78 lakh, body says crore. Sanction only, not a completed work; kept because four searches found no completed Khurja road, drain or other project in 2026.

statement_hindi: खुर्जा में रोज 6 से 8 घंटे बिजली कटौती झेलनी पड़ती है
statement_english: We face 6 to 8 hours of power cuts every day in Khurja
basis: Amar Ujala district-wide article (13 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr). Its table of average daily outages gives Khurja's own row as 6 to 8 hours (district-level article, Khurja row). Causes listed: summer overload, tripping and low voltage in the city, dilapidated lines and faults in rural areas. Chief Engineer says the system will be restored soon.

statement_hindi: जीटी रोड पर नाली नहीं, पानी भरता है और सड़क टूट रही है
statement_english: There are no drains on the GT road, so water collects and the road is breaking up
basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline, 30 Sep 2026): 7 km GT Road stretch from Agwal Cut to Kailash Hospital Cut, renovated for about Rs 14 crore, broke within about a year and a half; no drains, waterlogging at Dadu Pottery, Naveen Sabzi Mandi and other points; a pottery entrepreneur says waterlogging hurts business. PWD XEN says only renovation and widening were sanctioned and drain work depends on other departments submitting proposals.

statement_hindi: गांधी मार्ग पर डिवाइडर हटने से सुबह से शाम तक जाम रहता है
statement_english: Jams on Gandhi Marg run from morning to evening since the dividers were removed
basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline, 6 May 2026): temporary dividers at Padam Singh Gate and Kabari Bazar crossings removed after vehicles broke cement barricades. A shopkeeper says jams run from about 10 AM to 8 PM; shopkeepers say sales fell up to 40 percent (their claim); ambulances and school vehicles have trouble getting through. Nagar Palika EO says the damaged barricades were sent for budget approval.

statement_hindi: जटिया अस्पताल की 1919 की इमारत जर्जर है, दीवारें कमजोर हो गई हैं
statement_english: The 1919 building of Jatiya hospital in Khurja is dilapidated and its walls have weakened
basis: Amar Ujala (7 Sep 2026; district-wide report with a Khurja focus): Sri Lakshman Das Jatiya Rajkiya Chikitsalaya Khurja building dates to 1919, walls and lintels deteriorating; old staff quarters dilapidated with chhajjas that could fall. A chhajja of a roughly 100-year-old building on Subhash Marg fell on 19 July 2026 with no major accident. ADM says process under way to build new buildings.

statement_hindi: खुर्जा जंक्शन पर पीने का पानी नहीं, छांव भी कम, यात्री परेशान
statement_english: Khurja Junction has no working drinking water and little shade, and passengers face trouble
basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jun 2026; byline Ghaziabad Bureau, filed under Bulandshahr news; about Khurja Junction): Amrit Station 2.0 redevelopment (Rs 12.5 crore, virtual foundation Feb 2024) not finished; platforms 1 to 5 lack working drinking water, coolers on 1 to 4 broken. A commuter says the tin shed covers only about 30 m of the 600 m platform 3-4 stretch (his claim). Station Superintendent says old sheds will be removed after station work and a letter has gone out for cooler repairs.

statement_hindi: खैर-जट्टारी सड़क का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया, जाम कम होने की उम्मीद है
statement_english: Khair-Jattari road widening has started and people hope it will ease the jams
basis: Article says construction began 13 April from Arrana Kante to Hamidpur Yamuna bridge, cost about Rs 88 crore, target one year; MLA inspected the work

statement_hindi: खैर सीएचसी में लू के लिए चार बेड का कूलिंग वार्ड बन गया
statement_english: A four-bed cooling ward for heat relief has been set up at Khair CHC
basis: Cooling ward built next to CHC emergency with four beds; CHC president said the heat relief room will run as a permanent arrangement

statement_hindi: खैर का निबंधन दफ्तर खुला, पहले ही दिन 120 रजिस्ट्री हुईं
statement_english: Khair's registration office reopened and 120 registrations were done on the first day
basis: Registration work reopened on 3 July 2026 after the lawyers' protest ended; 120 registrations on the first day

statement_hindi: *खैर में जाम से राहत के लिए अलीगढ़-पलवल मार्ग पर बाईपास प्रस्तावित है
statement_english: *A bypass on the Aligarh-Palwal road is proposed at Khair to ease jams
basis: Inference: only a proposal awaiting board approval on 13 Aug 2026, not a started or completed project; included because no completed Khair-specific relief was found. Source gives 10 km, 35 m wide, about Rs 70 crore

statement_hindi: *खैर की 114 सड़कों के लिए 169 किमी की योजना आई है
statement_english: *A plan for 114 roads totalling 169 km has come for Khair constituency
basis: Inference: a plan figure from an Aligarh-division roads article, not confirmed as sanctioned or started; only the Khair constituency mention is Khair-specific

statement_hindi: खैर मंडी में पांच घंटे से ज़्यादा जाम, बच्चे देर से स्कूल पहुंचे
statement_english: More than five hours of jam at Khair mandi made students reach school late
basis: Jam from about 4 AM on Friday 25 Sep 2026 at Khair mandi on the Aligarh-Palwal road lasted over five hours; private school managers said students were delayed 1.5 to 2 hours; CO said police were short-staffed; paddy arrivals rose because Igalas and Dhanipur mandis were closed

statement_hindi: खैर में पथवारी मंदिर से सोमना बाईपास तक सड़क टूटी पड़ी है
statement_english: The road from the Pathwari temple to Somna bypass in Khair is badly broken
basis: Article names the road from the historic Pathwari temple in Khair to Somna bypass as badly damaged, about one km, in poor condition for a long time; the article is district-wide (Aligarh division roads) but names Khair

statement_hindi: खैर का निबंधन दफ्तर 25 दिन बंद रहा, रजिस्ट्री का काम ठप रहा
statement_english: Khair's registration office stayed shut for 25 days and registry work stopped
basis: Khair tehsil registration work was shut 25 days; lawyers boycotted the office from 9 June 2026 in protest against privatisation of registration; reopened 3 July 2026

statement_hindi: खैर मंडी में फसल खरीद के समय भारी जाम लगता है
statement_english: Khair mandi gets heavy jams during crop purchases
basis: Mandi Samiti Khair (in Khair town, namesake rule). DM visited on 31 Oct 2025 and heard traders; jams during paddy, wheat and potato purchase; token system to be introduced and alternate vehicle routes asked for. Replaces the earlier millet item, which was tehsil-level and not AC-specific

statement_hindi: हम किसान गर्मी में बिजली कटौती से परेशान हैं, बिजलीघर पर ज्ञापन दिया
statement_english: We farmers are troubled by power cuts in the heat and gave a memorandum at the substation
basis: District-level: farmers and villagers gave a memorandum at Jattari substation to the SDO, warning of protest; article gives no hours and names no village; does not name Khair; AC membership of Jattari unconfirmed

statement_hindi: थानपुर और हींसेल में इंटरलॉकिंग सड़कें बन गई हैं
statement_english: Interlocking roads have been built in Thanpur and Hinsail villages.
basis: Amar Ujala (16 Mar 2026): the Barauli MLA inaugurated a ~200 m interlocking road in Thanpur, stated as built from MLA fund, and a 600 m interlocking road from Hinsail to Nagla Sarua (funding not stated). A 1,600 m Hinsail-Nagla Sarua road only got a foundation stone, so it is not counted.

statement_hindi: यात्री शेड और बारात घर विधायक ने बनवाए
statement_english: A passenger shed and a barat ghar were built by the Barauli MLA.
basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024) reporter states the Barauli MLA got a passenger shed, barat ghar and similar works built; the article covers three ACs and the line sits in its Barauli section. Reporter's statement only; no cost or completion date given.

statement_hindi: हरदुआगंज उप मंडी में किसानों का धान खरीदा जा चुका है
statement_english: Farmers' paddy has already been bought at Harduaganj sub-mandi.
basis: Subkuz (13 Oct 2026) says the wet paddy kept at Harduaganj sub-mandi had already been bought from farmers. Weak positive: shows procurement took place, not that prices or payment were good.

statement_hindi: पलवल-अलीगढ़ हाईवे का निर्माण शुरू हो गया है
statement_english: Construction of the Palwal-Aligarh highway has started.
basis: District-level, not confirmed inside Barauli AC: Amar Ujala (19 Jul 2025) says construction of NH 334D Palwal-Tappal-Aligarh (72 km, department target two years) started at Kheshwar crossing. Khair, Jattari, Andla, Arrana, Rajpura and Lodha are named; Barauli is not.

statement_hindi: *हरदुआगंज-पिपली-भमराउला संपर्क मार्ग का पहला किलोमीटर बन चुका है
statement_english: *The first kilometre of the Harduaganj-Pipli-Bhamraula link road is built.
basis: Inference: a Newstrack search summary (about 100 days old, 2026) says the first 1 km of this 3.3 km link road is complete and the rest (2.3 km) awaits sanction from Mandi Parishad. The Newstrack page returned HTTP 403 on two attempts and was not opened, so no URL is cited. Harduaganj is in Barauli AC; Pipli and Bhamraula are not confirmed inside it.

statement_hindi: तीन साल से सड़क टूटी है, गड्ढों में बारिश का पानी भरता है
statement_english: The road has been broken for three years, and rainwater fills its potholes.
basis: Amar Ujala (30 Mar 2026): link road from a nagar panchayat (photo caption: Jawan) to the Barauli-Aligarh road, about 3 km, broken for three years; serves about six villages including Sumera and Faridpur. Gram pradhan says complaints were made many times with no action. AC membership: Wikipedia's Barauli extent lists Jawan Sikanderpur; the article itself does not name the nagar panchayat.

statement_hindi: हरदुआगंज उप मंडी में खुले में रखा धान बारिश में भीगा
statement_english: Paddy kept in the open at Harduaganj sub-mandi got soaked in the rain.
basis: Subkuz (13 Oct 2026): thousands of quintals of paddy kept in the open at Harduaganj sub-mandi were soaked by rain. The 20% loss fear and Rs 10 crore estimate in the article are for Khair mandi, so they are not used here. Harduaganj Nagar Panchayat is in Barauli AC per Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: खेड़ा बुजुर्ग साधु आश्रम मार्ग जर्जर है, आए दिन लोग चोटिल होते हैं
statement_english: The Sadhu Ashram road in Kheda Bujurg is badly broken, and people keep falling and getting hurt on it.
basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024): former Kheda Bujurg pradhan Chandrabhan Singh says 'साधु आश्रम मार्ग बेहद जर्जर है' and 'आए दिन लोग गिरकर चोटिल हो रहे हैं'. The article places Kheda Bujurg in its Barauli section; it covers three ACs, and no later report was found for this road.

statement_hindi: मेमडी-छलेसर, मुजफ्फरा-गोधा, गोपालपुर-कासिमपुर सड़कें जर्जर हैं
statement_english: The Memdi-Chhaleser, Mujaffara-Godha and Gopalpur-Kasimpur roads are broken.
basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024) lists these three roads under its own heading 'बरौली विधानसभा की जर्जर सड़कें' (dilapidated roads of Barauli assembly), with no speaker or individual description. Weak: a list, not a quote; field check needed. The article covers three ACs.

statement_hindi: *आवारा पशु खेत उजाड़ देते हैं, फसल बचाना मुश्किल
statement_english: *Stray cattle destroy crops and farmers struggle to protect their fields.
basis: Inference: no Barauli- or Aligarh-specific 2024-26 report was found in about 40 searches (Hindi and English). Only western and Bundelkhand UP coverage turned up. Not confirmed as a Barauli problem; a field check is needed.

statement_hindi: गांवों में डिजिटल लाइब्रेरी और शमशान घाट का उद्घाटन हो गया
statement_english: Digital libraries and cremation grounds in village panchayats have been inaugurated
basis: Amar Ujala (19 Apr 2026, verified): the state minister inaugurated about Rs 5 crore of projects in Atrauli block: 33 kshetra panchayat works (Rs 2.5 crore), digital libraries in 33 gram panchayats (Rs 1.32 crore), cremation grounds in 4 gram panchayats (Rs 1.20 crore). The article names no villages, so each work's exact AC membership is not confirmed. Block-level, and the works are delivered (inaugurated), not just planned.

statement_hindi: सड़कों के टेंडर हो गए, अब काम शुरू होने का इंतजार है
statement_english: Tenders for new roads are done, now we wait for construction to start
basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026, verified): 12 roads worth about Rs 21 crore, tendered under the CM rural road scheme. Six are in Atrauli rural area, about Rs 9.96 crore by addition (e.g. Tarechi to Sirsa Rs 2.32 crore; Pendhara to Rajgaon Gazipur Rs 1.95 crore; Pahadgarhi to Nahal Panehra Rs 1.64 crore). The report names these under Atrauli vidhan sabha. The article says construction will start soon. Tender stage only; no completion reported.

statement_hindi: गांवों की कच्ची सड़कें पक्की बनाने का काम मंजूर हुआ है
statement_english: Unpaved village roads in Atrauli block have been sanctioned for construction
basis: Amar Ujala (1 Nov 2024, verified): about Rs 2.5 crore from the kshetra panchayat for roads in several villages of Atrauli block that had been unpaved since independence; tenders issued; construction to finish in three months. Block-level report, no village list, so AC membership is not separately confirmed. Dated 2024; completion not confirmed in any later source found.

statement_hindi: अमृत सरोवर बना तो सुबह-शाम यहीं घूमने आते थे
statement_english: Amrit Sarovar built in Naoari had villagers walking there morning and evening
basis: Amar Ujala (19 Mar 2026, verified): Amrit Sarovar in Naoari gram panchayat (Atrauli block), built in 2023, with benches and a walking path around it. Villagers initially came morning and evening and sat by the clear water. Past benefit only; the pond has since dried (see negative 5). Naoari's AC membership is not confirmed: it is not in the Wikipedia extent and no source named it.

statement_hindi: शहर में सफाई और हरियाली का अभियान शुरू हुआ है
statement_english: A cleanliness and greening drive has started in town
basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026, verified): Atrauli municipal board installed Green Atrauli-Clean Atrauli cutouts and lighting at the Avantibai crossing and an I Love Atrauli selfie point at the roadways bus stand; the chairman says a tree-planting drive will run in every ward (no dates). The article quotes no residents by name and reports no measurable results. Campaign stage, so the weakest positive here.

statement_hindi: बिजली 10 की जगह 4-5 घंटे मिलती है, मक्का खतरे में है
statement_english: Power comes for only 4-5 hours instead of 10, and the maize is at risk
basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026, verified): for about 15 days farmers on the Paneha feeder (Atrauli area; Rajatau and Nahal named) got 4-5 hours instead of 10, with repeated trips and no daytime irrigation; maize at risk; farmers demand 12 hours. The JE blames overloading and says it will be resolved soon. Second source, Aligarh Media (18 Jul 2026, local outlet, verified): Panehra village (Atrauli) faced a power crisis and low voltage, and villagers gave a memorandum to the DM on 15 Jul. AC membership: Nahal Panehra is named under Atrauli vidhan sabha in the 11 Oct 2026 Amar Ujala report. Panehra village's own AC membership is not separately confirmed.

statement_hindi: अतरौली-गनियावली-गाजीपुर सड़क पर गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: Atrauli-Ganiyavli-Gazipur road is full of potholes and gets waterlogged in rain
basis: Amar Ujala (26 May 2026, verified): the Atrauli-Ganiyavli-Gazipur road is in poor condition; the Yuva Pahal president says large potholes and waterlogging disrupt travel in rains, hitting school children, patients and farmers. The BDO says a complaint letter will go to PWD. A dharna on the same demand was held on 1 Jan 2023 with no action since. The road starts in Atrauli town, so AC membership follows the namesake-town rule.

statement_hindi: काली नदी पर पुल सिर्फ कागज पर है, अभी तक बना नहीं
statement_english: Kali river bridge is still only on paper, not built yet
basis: Amar Ujala (16 May 2025, verified): a 120 m bridge over the Kali river on Godha Road, Jawan area, near Gobli village, estimated at Rs 16.50 crore. The UP Setu Nigam sent the detailed plan to the state government; sanction pending; construction not started. The article says the bridge would spare residents on both banks long detours. Gobli is in the AC extent on Wikipedia. No later report on approval or construction was found in searches, so the status after May 2025 is unconfirmed; a field check is recommended. The earlier Wire (2022) claims were dropped because the page body could not be read.

statement_hindi: यूरिया के लिए लाइन में लगते हैं, मिलती है बस दो बोरी
statement_english: We queue for urea from morning, but get only two bags
basis: Amar Ujala (5 Aug 2025, verified): at the Atrauli PCF centre and cooperative society, farmers from Gaziapur, Harchandpur and Khera queued from about 5 am in rain; they needed 5-10 bags and got two each; there was a scuffle with police; private shops also lacked urea. The secretary says distribution matched the stock. Dated 2025; no later urea report for Atrauli was found. The PCF centre is in Atrauli town, so it counts under the namesake-town rule.

statement_hindi: अमृत सरोवर सूख गया है, वहां गोबर रखा जा रहा है
statement_english: The Amrit Sarovar has dried up and cow dung is kept there
basis: Amar Ujala (19 Mar 2026, verified): the Amrit Sarovar in Naoari gram panchayat, Atrauli block, built in 2023, has dried; dung cakes are stacked on the flag platform and dung is spread across the dry pond. The report implies neglect but quotes no villager. Naoari's AC membership is not confirmed, so this is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

statement_hindi: *छर्रा की मंडी में फसल बेचने की अपनी जगह है
statement_english: *The Chharra mandi gives our farmers a local place to sell their crops
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026, checked) names the Chharra Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti as the site where a porter was injured in a dispute with traders on 22 Sep. The article does not describe farmers using the mandi or praising it; appreciation is inferred. Chharra town is the namesake town of AC 74, so the mandi is inside the AC.

statement_hindi: गालिबपुर की प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क गांवों को मुख्य रास्ते से जोड़ती है
statement_english: The PM Gram Sadak road from Galibpur is the main link for our villages
basis: Amar Ujala (2 Jul 2026, checked): resident Vinod Kumar says the about 1.5 km road from Galibpur gram panchayat (Gangiri block) to the Chharra-Kasganj route is 'कई गांवों के लोगों के लिए मुख्य संपर्क मार्ग है' (the main link for many villages). AC membership unconfirmed: Galibpur is not named in the AC's Wikipedia extent. District-level. The road is in poor condition, so this praises its role, not its state.

statement_hindi: *त्योहार की सवारी के लिए छर्रा में सुरक्षा का इंतज़ाम हुआ
statement_english: *Security arrangements were made for the festival procession in Chharra
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Oct 2026, checked on the video page; headline and summary only) reports the SSP inspected the Ram Barat procession route in Chharra, the Ravan dahan site, and gave security instructions to organisers. The report does not record any resident's praise; appreciation is inferred. A security check is not a delivered benefit, so this is a weak positive.

statement_hindi: *छर्रा की 79 सड़कों के लिए 216 करोड़ रुपये का बजट है
statement_english: *Rs 216 crore budget is set aside for 79 roads in Chharra
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked) budget list gives Rs 216 crore for 79 roads of 250 km in the Chharra assembly area. This is a budget allocation, not a started or completed work; no resident praise is reported. Weak positive.

statement_hindi: *अतरौली-कासगंज राज्य मार्ग से छर्रा के बाहर के शहरों तक जाते हैं
statement_english: *The Atrauli-Kasganj state road takes us to towns beyond Chharra
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked) calls the Atrauli-Kasganj road a state highway that passes Pali Morh and Chharra Adda. The article names no destination towns and reports no resident praise; the appreciation is inferred and this is the weakest positive in the set.

statement_hindi: अतरौली-कासगंज रोड पर पाली मोड़ से छर्रा अड्डा तक गहरे गड्ढे हैं
statement_english: The Atrauli-Kasganj road has deep potholes from Pali Morh to Chharra Adda
basis: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked), reporter narration with no named speaker: 'अतरौली-कासगंज रोड पर पाली मोड़ से छर्रा अड्डा तक एक किलोमीटर के टुकड़े में गहरे गड्ढे हैं', state highway. Article covers 17 ACs in four districts, so it is district-level, but Chharra Adda is inside Chharra town (Chharra NP), listed in the AC's Wikipedia extent.

statement_hindi: छर्रा मंडी में पल्लेदार पर व्यापारियों के हमले का आरोप है
statement_english: A porter at the Chharra mandi is alleged to have been assaulted by traders in a dispute
basis: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026, checked): porter Raju was injured on 22 Sep at the Chharra Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti; the family alleges assault by two traders; FIR against 8 named persons and about 90 people in all (about 30 women); villagers allege police were not taking the case seriously (allegation only). Traders' version not in article. Police gave a different time for the incident (about 10:30 pm) than the family (about 8 pm).

statement_hindi: नानऊ से छर्रा-सांकरा सड़क जर्जर हो चुकी है
statement_english: The Nanau to Chharra-Sankra road is damaged
basis: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked), reporter narration with no named speaker: 'अकराबाद में जीटी रोड स्थित नानऊ चौराहे से छर्रा-सांकरा जाने वाली सड़क भी जर्जर हो चुकी है'. Nanau Chauraha is on GT road in Akarabad, and Akarabad KC is in AC 74's extent (Wikipedia), so the road starts inside AC 74. Sankra is not confirmed. Counted as AC-specific. The article covers 17 ACs in the Aligarh division, so the source is district-level.

statement_hindi: गालिबपुर की सड़क में गहरे गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल
statement_english: The Galibpur road has deep potholes and is hard to use in rain
basis: Amar Ujala (2 Jul 2026, checked): the PMGSY road from Galibpur gram panchayat (Gangiri block) to the Chharra-Kasganj route has deep potholes that fill with rainwater, so drivers cannot judge their depth; resident Vinod Kumar says 'हालत इतनी खराब हो चुकी है कि बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल हो जाता है'. Galibpur is not named in the AC 74 extent on Wikipedia: AC membership unconfirmed, so not counted as AC-specific. No official speaks in the article.

statement_hindi: *इलाज के लिए अलीगढ़ 40 किमी दूर, सिर्फ सड़क से जा सकते हैं
statement_english: *For treatment, Aligarh is 40 km away and it can only be reached by road
basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Chharra Rafatpur, undated, checked) says the town is '40 km from district headquarters Aligarh' and 'The only way to commute to this place is by road'. The page names no hospital or health service; the health-access claim is inferred from distance and road-only access. The page describes it as a nagar panchayat in Aligarh district, and the AC page lists Chharra NP in the extent.

statement_hindi: *खबर छपते ही सोलर तार बदला गया, नलों में पानी आने लगा
statement_english: *After a newspaper report, the stolen solar wire was replaced and water reached taps
basis: Inference: Siyakhas (Jawan block, Aligarh district) is outside Koil per the AC-76 polling-part list check, so this is not an AC 75 benefit. Kept only because no Koil-extent positive was found this round. Amar Ujala 15 Sep 2026 (checked): 'गांव सिया खास में बनी पानी की टंकी व पाइप लाइन से सोलर वायर चोरी हो गई थी।'; a new wire was installed and 'ग्रामीणों के घरों में अब नलों से पानी आना शुरू हो गया है।' The article says the original report ran on Monday (14 Sep). Koil does not appear in the article.

statement_hindi: *कोल में विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण और शिलान्यास हुआ
statement_english: *Development works in Koil were inaugurated and their foundations laid
basis: Inference: an event report, not a delivered benefit. Amar Ujala live blog 22 Jun 2026 (verified): the CM inaugurated and laid foundations for works in Aligarh Sadar, Koil assembly and the municipal corporation at Numaish Ground; no Koil project is named

statement_hindi: *अलीगढ़ में 462 करोड़ से ज्यादा की 85 विकास परियोजनाओं का लोकार्पण हुआ
statement_english: *85 development projects worth over Rs 462 crore were inaugurated in Aligarh
basis: Inference: an event, not a delivered benefit. Sangrah Rajneeti (verified): 85 projects worth over Rs 462 crore for Aligarh, with the event covering Aligarh city and Koil assembly constituency; no Koil project is named. The article dateline is 23 Jun 2026 and it describes the event as Monday (22 Jun)

statement_hindi: *अलीगढ़ में 105 करोड़ की ड्रेन योजना मंजूर, काम अभी शुरू नहीं हुआ
statement_english: *In Aligarh, a Rs 105 crore RCC drain plan is approved but work has not begun
basis: Inference: city-wide approval only; no Koil ward is named. Amar Ujala 6 Aug 2026 (verified): State Level Apex Committee approved Rs 105.28 crore for a 6.2 km RCC drain from Kwarsi crossing to Boneere nala; construction waits for the CM's final approval

statement_hindi: *कई चीनी मिलों ने गन्ना किसानों का पूरा भुगतान कर दिया
statement_english: *Many sugar mills have paid cane farmers their full dues
basis: Inference: statewide figure only. UNI 16 Sep 2026 (verified): 102 sugar mills made 100 pc payment to cane farmers in the 2025-26 crushing season; 23 cooperative mills paid Rs 2,820 crore. No Aligarh or Koil figure in the report

statement_hindi: मैरिस रोड पर नालियां ओवरफ्लो, गंदा पानी सड़क पर आता है
statement_english: Drains on Maris Road overflow and dirty water comes onto the road
basis: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2024, checked): 'पानी की निकासी के लिए जो नालियां हैं वह भी ओवरफ्लो रहती हैं जिससे गंदा पानी सड़क पर आ जाता है' and 'बरसात के दिनों में तो यहां से निकलना संभव ही नहीं है'. Amar Ujala (19 Sep 2025, checked): 'इतना ही नहीं नाला सड़क से ऊंचा बना दिया गया', and residents' drain defect complaints led to a three-member probe. Koil is not named in either report; Maris Road is placed in AC 75 by the AC-76 polling-part list the user supplied (that list was not re-opened: aligarh.nic.in was not found in search). The 2025 report's minister and probe details are not used in the statement.

statement_hindi: कोल की सड़कों का टेंडर हुआ, पर बनना अभी शुरू नहीं हुआ
statement_english: Koil roads have tenders but construction has not started
basis: Amar Ujala 11 Oct 2026 (verified): tenders issued for 12 roads worth Rs 21 crore under the Mukhyamantri Gramin Sadak Yojana, six of them in the Koil seat (e.g. Manoharpur Kayastha to Bhakrola); PWD Superintending Engineer says construction will start soon and no work has started yet

statement_hindi: क्वार्सी बाईपास का बंबा गंदगी से भरा है, सफाई पर ध्यान नहीं
statement_english: The bamba on Quarsi bypass is clogged with garbage and not being cleaned
basis: Amar Ujala video report (5 Mar 2026, checked, headline and summary): 'अलीगढ़ के क्वार्सी बाईपास स्थित बंबा गंदगी से अटा हुआ है', 'जनता बंबा में गंदगी डाल रही है', and 'बंबा की सफाई करने वाला विभाग का इस ओर ध्यान नहीं है'. Quarsi is placed in AC 75 by the AC-76 polling-part list the user supplied (not re-opened). No official or resident is quoted in the visible text.

statement_hindi: कोल तहसील के रजिस्ट्री दफ्तर में लेनदेन का आरोप है
statement_english: There is an allegation of transactions at the Koil tehsil registry office
basis: Amar Ujala 1 Apr 2026 (verified): a seven-minute video circulating online alleges transactions at the Koil tehsil registry office; AIG (Stamp) has started an inquiry. Allegation only, no findings reported

statement_hindi: *गंगीरी में 24 घंटे में सिर्फ चार-पांच घंटे बिजली मिल रही है
statement_english: *Farmers say they get only four to five hours of power in 24 hours at Gangiri
